# Sisk Framework

> Sisk is a lightweight, agnostic and robust .NET web development framework.

Sisk is an open-source HTTP server framework for .NET written in C#. It is an explicit alternative to ASP.NET for building REST APIs, WebSocket and Server-Sent Events services, JSON-RPC and MCP servers, and static file servers. Install it with `dotnet add package Sisk.HttpServer`.

Every documentation and API page is available as Markdown by replacing `.html` with `.md` in its URL. This index lists the Deutsch translation; the English original is at https://docs.sisk-framework.org/llms.txt.

- Full documentation in one file: https://docs.sisk-framework.org/de/llms-full.txt
- Complete API reference index: https://docs.sisk-framework.org/api/index.md
